row.evidence: Dagster's pricing table marks SSO, SAML and "SCIM provisioning — Okta, Entra ID" as unavailable on Solo and Starter, so they are Pro-only (Contact Sales); the SCIM guides list "A Pro plan" as a prerequisite.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: gated at Pro (Contact Sales). Solo $10/mo + $0.040/credit (1 user) and Starter $100/mo + $0.035/credit (up to 3 users) are flat, usage-priced and shown monthly only. The pricing page now says "Dagster is now part of Prefect". SCIM is documented for Okta and Entra ID only and requires SSO set up first; deprovisioning removes the user from the organization. June's mention of Google/GitHub SCIM is not supported by current docs and was dropped. User/team management outside SCIM is via an early-access Terraform provider; audit logs via GraphQL API on Pro.

auth.token_source: Organization Settings > Provisioning > Enable SCIM provisioning > Create SCIM token
auth.notes: Okta app uses an API Token field; Entra uses Tenant URL + Secret Token. Exact header scheme not documented by Dagster.

endpoints.notes: Inferred from Users and Groups provisioning; no SCIM endpoint reference is published.

operations.notes: Updates are documented but not whether PUT or PATCH is used. Deactivation removes the user from the organization.

filtering.notes: From the Entra tutorial's 'Supported for filtering' column.

attributes.notes: Okta guide limits sync to firstName, lastName, email (must match Okta username) and displayName.

roles.how: SCIM does not set roles; sync IdP groups to Dagster+ Teams and assign roles to teams in the Dagster+ UI. New SSO users get sso_default_role (Viewer by default).

limitations.text: SCIM provisioning is documented only for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
Adding users in Dagster+ is disabled while SCIM is on; only unsynced users can be removed in Dagster+.
Okta sync supports only firstName, lastName, email and displayName.
Disabling SCIM leaves users and teams as they were.
Terraform provider is an early prototype; functionality and APIs may change.

user_api.notes: No public user-management REST/GraphQL reference. The early-access Terraform provider (dagster-io/dagsterplus) manages users and teams with a Dagster+ user token. The GraphQL API is documented for audit logs.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked (read from page markup).

google.notes: Dagster documents Google Workspace SSO; SCIM is not supported for Google and users must be added in Dagster+ first.

onelogin.notes: Dagster has a OneLogin SSO guide; OneLogin is not in the SCIM-supported list. OneLogin catalogue not checked (bot-blocked).

fallbacks.notes: New SSO users are created on first login with sso_default_role unless it is NO_ACCESS; Google SSO users must be pre-added.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, version and PUT vs PATCH are not documented by Dagster.
Docs do not say whether removing a user via SCIM frees a seat or ends active sessions.
Which plan can use the Terraform provider for user/team management is not stated; teams are a Pro feature.
